sample_rows.トピック: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Current account: Goods, services & income
sample_rows.指標名: Imports of goods, services and primary income (current US$)
sample_rows.簡潔な定義: Imports of goods, services and primary income is the sum of goods (merchandise) imports, imports of (nonfactor) services and income (factor) payments. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.詳細説明: Imports of goods, services and income is the sum of goods (merchandise) imports, imports of (nonfactor) services and primary income (factor) payments. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.ソース: International Monetary Fund, Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook.

sample_rows.トピック: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Current account: Balances
sample_rows.簡潔な定義: Current account balance shows the difference between the sum of exports and income receivable and the sum of imports and income payable (exports and imports refer to both goods and services, while income refers to both primary and secondary income).
sample_rows.詳細説明: Current account balance shows the difference between the sum of exports and income receivable and the sum of imports and income payable (exports and imports refer to both goods and services, while income refers to both primary and secondary income).
sample_rows.ソース: International Monetary Fund, Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook.

sample_rows.トピック: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Reserves & other items
sample_rows.簡潔な定義: Grants are defined as legally binding commitments that obligate a specific value of funds available for disbursement for which there is no repayment requirement. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.詳細説明: Grants are defined as legally binding commitments that obligate a specific value of funds available for disbursement for which there is no repayment requirement. Data are in current U.S. dollars.

sample_rows.トピック: Economic Policy & Debt: Balance of payments: Reserves & other items
sample_rows.簡潔な定義: Technical cooperation grants include free-standing technical cooperation grants, which are intended to finance the transfer of technical and managerial skills or of technology for the purpose of building up general national capacity without reference to any specific investment projects; and investment-related technical cooperation grants, which are provided to strengthen the capacity to execute specific investment projects. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
sample_rows.詳細説明: Technical cooperation grants include free-standing technical cooperation grants, which are intended to finance the transfer of technical and managerial skills or of technology for the purpose of building up general national capacity without reference to any specific investment projects; and investment-related technical cooperation grants, which are provided to strengthen the capacity to execute specific investment projects. Data are in current U.S. dollars.
